run_ensemble_answers_by_confidence: run the ensemble_answers_by_confidence_script to ensemble RoBERTA model predictions for HotpotQA
ensemble_model_predictions: ensemble nbest predictions from multiple model seeds using weighted averaging of probabilities and logits
evaluate_ensemble_predictions: evaluate ensembled HotpotQA predictions against gold answers and compute gn_f1 metrics
ensemble_all_pairs: ensemble all pairwise combinations of two model prediction files and print mean/std metrics
ensemble_single_model_predictions: ensemble predictions from a single model across multiple random seeds and save results
